svg.text: Layout reference generated from the game data — not the artwork. Regions are roughly equal in area; boundaries are trails, not tile edges.
⛏ Rock & Ruin — Bare rock. Scree, quarry faces, broken masonry, nothing growing.
❦ Root & Rot — Deep dank forest. Closed canopy, moss to the knee, standing deadwood.
☙ Fur & Feather — Meadow and light woods. Open grass, scattered alder, good sightlines.
≈ Rain & River — Woodsy creek bottom. Runs right through the map rather than sitting in one place.
⚙ Grease & Gravel — Logged out. Stumps, slash piles, churned mud, a road going nowhere.
▤ Forms & Procedures — An abandoned, dilapidated ranger station and its outbuildings.
✷ Dark & Distant — The same forest, at night. Identical ground, wrong light.
The Deep Woods — 10 places. Late afternoon. The light is going.
The Narrows — 7 places. Dusk. You can still see the ground.
The Last Mile — 4 places. Full dark. Whatever is out here can see better than you.
▲ vantage point — survive here and the Director tells you something
The creek runs right through the board, from the edge to the Trailhead.
